title: Decision-Aware Calibration Limits

protocol.policy: Require certificate residual gate and agreement of all three nominal+gain-corner classifications, including unchanged fit and margin thresholds.

limitations: Gain corner ±.05 is an assumption, not a statistically valid confidence interval.
The true gain may lie outside the assumed neighborhood even when certificate residual passes; safe behavior outside tested family is unproved.
One certificate estimate and one fixed initial state; no external validation or independent sensor ancestry.
Residual-check challenge uses known synthetic generator; a matching error may pass due to calibration blind spots.
Withholding authorization does not guarantee system stability or a safe fallback.
No implemented physical energy, fusion, weak/strong forces or Planck-scale physics.
